notes: GST 5% from 1 Jan 2026 (GST Act 2020 as amended 2025, Schedule I), replacing the old sales tax. The complete Schedule IV exemption list was read: no gold item. Schedule V para 13 zero-rates only a refiners first supply of investment-form metal to a dealer, so retail bullion takes 5%. Customs duty: HS 7108 = 2.5% all lines; silver 7106 = 4%; 5% GST also at import.

sources.name: Department of Revenue & Customs (drc.gov.bt) - Consolidated GST Act of Bhutan 2020 and Amendment, Schedule I
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: other than the zero rate in Schedule V, the applicable GST rate on taxable supplies and imports is 5%; Schedule IV exemptions contain no gold
sources.quote: Other than the zero rate prescribed in Schedule V, the applicable GST rate on taxable supplies and taxable imports of goods and services shall be 5%.
